title: Vize lib source registry
description: registry/registry.json shipped inside the @vizejs/ui and @vizejs/composable npm tarballs. Describes every source unit `vize lib pull` can copy into a project. Raw files live under <registry dir>/<filesDirectory>/<files[].path>. The registry is immutable per published package version.

schemaVersion.description: Document schema version. Consumers must reject versions they do not understand.

package.description: npm package and exact version that published this registry.

kind.description: Kind shared by every item in this registry.

filesDirectory.description: Directory, relative to registry.json, that holds files[].path.

defaultTargetDirectory.description: Project-relative directory used when neither --dir nor vize.config lib.dir is set.

relativePath.description: POSIX path relative to the package src/ directory; never absolute and never contains '..'.

role.description: entry: public re-export module; component: Vue SFC; style: side-effect CSS; types: type-only module; module: other runtime module.

aliases.description: Alternate names accepted by info/pull, sorted and unique.

packageSubpath.description: Package export subpath exposing the same unit.

files.description: Files owned by this item, sorted by path. Test files are never published.

registryDependencies.description: Complete transitive closure of other item names this item imports through relative paths, sorted.

dependencies.description: npm packages imported by this item's own files, sorted by name.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 over path + NUL + sha256 + LF for every file in path order.
